# IntrinsicDynamicsAutonomy

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The capacity of a neuromorphic reservoir to generate its own computational states from physical dynamics (e.g., spiking, relaxation) without external perturbation or programming. Reduces reliance on external control units, enabling self-sustaining in-network computation that is robust and low-latency for iNEST applications.
